description: Lists the stores Basko covers in a country: their kind, whether their prices are compared now, where the prices come from, delivery fees and links to their sites. With latitude and longitude, also each store's nearest branches with the distance and opening hours (branches are known in Uzbekistan).

branches.description: How many nearest branches per store (1 to 10, default 3).

country.description: The country whose stores to read: UZ (Uzbekistan), KZ (Kazakhstan), RU (Russia), US (United States), GB or UK (United Kingdom).

lang.description: Language of texts and amounts in the answer, as a BCP 47 tag (en, ru, uz, uz-Cyrl, kk, es, …). Default: the assistant's locale, else the country's main language.

latitude.description: Where to look for branches near (with longitude).

longitude.description: Where to look for branches near (with latitude).

store.description: Only this store. Store ids come from find_stores (korzinka, walmart-us, tesco-uk, …).

name: find_stores

attribution.description: the credit the branch data asks for

amount.description: the amount in the currency's main unit (dollars, pounds, so'm, tenge, roubles)

text.description: the amount as written in the answer's language

freeOver.description: orders from this amount are delivered free

amount.description: the amount in the currency's main unit (dollars, pounds, so'm, tenge, roubles)

text.description: the amount as written in the answer's language

published.description: false when the store shows its delivery fee only at checkout

openNow.description: left out when the hours aren't known

shownApart.description: its listings are shown apart, never compared (eBay)

status.description: live (its prices are compared) or comingSoon

weeklyOffers.description: it has an offers page running now (get_deals with its id reads it)

title: Find stores and branches
